issues.remediation: Prevent the skill from modifying its own code, SKILL.md, or configuration files. Treat skill files as read-only at runtime.

reason, evidence, and old → new claim when changed. Preserve original observations, resolution, promotion targets/dates, and prior reviews. issues.pattern: “Knowledge gaps” and “Model behavior surprise” are ambiguous learning-capture triggers.
issues.finding: “Knowledge gaps” and “Model behavior surprise” are ambiguous learning-capture triggers.
issues.explanation: These conditions do not define what qualifies as a knowledge gap or an unexpected model behavior worth capturing. Unlike the concrete command-failure trigger, they could activate learning capture for routine uncertainty or harmless response variation; validation before promotion does not constrain initial capture.
issues.remediation: Define observable activation criteria, such as a verified factual error or a task-blocking missing fact, and add exclusions for routine uncertainty, exploratory questions, and harmless stylistic variation.
